header.description: Attention-head DBM: a plain swap through a gate featurizer grouped by head. The gate sits on attention_premix - the o-projection's input, head-major - and holds ONE theta per head, expanded over that head's coordinates, so the mask it fits selects heads: sigma(theta_h)*x_src + (1-sigma(theta_h))*x_base on every coordinate of head h. Group map (heads, head_dim) derived from (model, site) and stamped into the bundle; the l1 term is the mean soft mask over heads, so the penalty is the selected-head count, and fit_diagnostics.json's hard_mask_size counts heads. Layer 19 is a full-attention layer of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (layer_types repeat 3 DeltaNet + 1 full attention); on a Gated DeltaNet layer set sites.target.component to delta_premix - the out-projection's input, value-head space - and the same document masks value heads. Flat rather than an application of methods/dbm.json because the gate unit, the component and the penalty's meaning all differ from the per-coordinate residual-stream fit. train.eval.split is the held-out validation split; iia.json is the TRAIN score - read train_eval.json for the validation one and dbm_head_apply.json for a confirmation replay. As with dbm.json, gate on decisive_fraction before believing a number: the l1 weight below is a starting point, not a tuned one.
